Chess pieces by Colin M.L. Burnett ("Cburnett"), Wikimedia Commons.
Source files: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:SVG_chess_pieces/Standard_transparent
(Chess_klt45.svg, Chess_qlt45.svg, Chess_rlt45.svg, Chess_blt45.svg, Chess_nlt45.svg, Chess_plt45.svg and the
matching *dt45.svg files). The author released them under GFDL, BSD and GPL; this app uses them under the BSD
